info.title: Bundu standards
info.description: standards.bundu.org: the register of the open standards the Bundu, Mukoko and Nyuchi platform builds on, our own published standards, and the register's files at any commit. Read-only: every route answers GET and HEAD (and an OPTIONS preflight); any other method is a 405. Pages accept their path with or without the trailing slash; the canonical form is listed. No route takes a query parameter; the query string is ignored. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Nothing needs authentication. The routes are checked against the Worker's router by `cargo test` (workers/standards-api/src/openapi.rs).
